subject: Request: temporary QPS lift and provisional true-up for launch
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@brightapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightApps Engineering <infra@brightapps.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary QPS lift for upcoming launch

Hi Connor / Lauren,

We have a hard launch planned for 2027-07-15 (marketing has pinned it). Predictive traffic looks like a spike to ~3x our normal QPS for a 36-hour window starting 07/15 00:00 UTC. Can Redwood provide a provisional QPS uplift for that window?

Key asks:
- Headroom to sustain the spike (expected 36 hours).
- A clear pricing path: either (a) short-term uplift surcharge, or (b) a temporary flat rate for the window.
- Any discount available if we commit to do a post-launch true-up / migrate more volume to a committed tier.

Attached: launch-runbook.pdf (traffic projections + fallbacks).

Timing: we need a proposal by EOD 07/11 to feed procurement and get a PO in time.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Senior Product Manager
BrightApps

---
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@brightapps.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary QPS lift for upcoming launch

Hi Maya — thanks for the runbook, looks clear. We can support a provisional uplift for the 36-hour window; below is an outline of two feasible options and the requirements for each.

Option A — Uplift surcharge (recommended for immediate turnaround)
- Provisioned headroom: +200% of baseline QPS for 36 hours starting 07/15 00:00 UTC.
- Billing: uplift traffic billed at 1.4x your current per-token/generation rate.
- Reconciliation: standard monthly true-up; uplift is included in the invoice for July and reconciled against any committed volume in the Aug true-up.
- Approval path: written amendment or PO confirming dates and cap.

Option B — Temporary flat-rate window (better predictability, requires PO)
- Flat price covering the entire uplift window (we'd estimate usage per runbook).
- Needs a PO or signed amendment before we provision.

Discount concession proposal (for either option)
- If BrightApps commits to a post-launch true-up (3-month review to convert uplift volume to a commit) we can apply a 20% discount on the uplift surcharge for the first 7 days after launch. This is conditional on legal-approved amendment / PO.

Operational notes
- We require a signed amendment or PO by 07/13 23:59 UTC to guarantee provisioning and reserve capacity.
- Attachments I intend to send: amendment draft (amendment-brightapps-uplift.pdf) and a proforma (proforma-brightapps-july.xlsx).

If that approach works, I can provision a soft cap for the window (guard rails + automatic fallback to lower-cost model variants if you hit limits).

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightApps uplift request — pricing ask

Lauren / Ben — forwarding BrightApps' ask. Quick summary and my recommendation:
- Ask: temporary +200% headroom for ~36 hours starting 07/15.
- My proposed commercial: 1.4x uplift surcharge, with a 20% discount on that uplift for 7 days if they sign the amendment and agree to a 3-month post-launch true-up review.
- Must have PO/amendment signed by 07/13 to provision.

I'm looking for fast approval on the 20% concession (applies only to uplift surcharge, not baseline usage). Also flagging potential cap: limit the uplift billing exposure to $75k for the window (we can set a hard cap they must approve).

Notes on risk: if actual usage exceeds projections significantly we will fall back to the next available model variant — want to include that in the amendment.

Can you confirm: (1) approve 20% uplift discount, (2) approve $75k provisional cap, (3) confirm if legal should review amendment or we can proceed with standard amendment template?

Connor

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightApps uplift request — pricing ask

Connor / Lauren — I approve the 20% concession on uplift for the 7-day post-launch period and the $75k provisional billing cap.
A few constraints:
- Discount applies only to uplift traffic and expires after the 7-day window.
- We should add a clause that if uplift usage (tokens billed) is >2.5x forecasted, we reserve the right to convert to a higher uplift surcharge to protect capacity economics; notify customer if trigger occurs.
- Legal should review the amendment for the fallback clause language; please loop legal but we can use the standard amendment template as the starting point.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

---
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@brightapps.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, BrightApps Engineering <infra@brightapps.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirming provisional uplift and next steps (BrightApps / BRG-2027-045)

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal approvals, here are the confirmed terms we can provision:

Confirmed provisional uplift (BrightApps — BRG-2027-045)
- Window: 2027-07-15 00:00 UTC through 2027-07-16 12:00 UTC (36 hours).
- Provisioned headroom: +200% baseline QPS.
- Billing model: uplift traffic billed at 1.4x current per-token rate.
- Concession: 20% discount applied to uplift surcharge for the first 7 days post-launch (conditional on signed amendment / PO).
- Provisional billing cap: $75,000 for the uplift window — if usage projects to exceed the cap we'll notify you and pause additional provisioning unless you authorize.
- Fallbacks: automatic model-variant fallback to preserve stability; legal amendment includes trigger clause if uplift >2.5x forecast.

Required next steps (time-sensitive)
1) Please sign the amendment sent via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/brightapps/amendment/XYZ-789 or send an equivalent PO referencing BRG-2027-045 by 2027-07-13 23:59 UTC.
2) We will provision soft capacity once we receive signed PO/amendment.
3) Send any updated runbook details to infra@brightapps.com so the on-call team can review fallback playbooks.

Attachments: amendment-brightapps-uplift.pdf (amendment draft), proforma-brightapps-july.xlsx (pro forma invoice), launch-runbook.pdf (your runbook copy).

If you confirm, I'll start provisioning immediately.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
